newsitem.title: USA: High Plains Wheat - Gulf, interior bids weaken.
newsitem.headline: High Plains Wheat - Gulf, interior bids weaken.

text.p: Basis bids for hard red winter wheat weakened at both Gulf and interior locations as grain merchandisers reacted to a slowdown in demand, dealers in the U.S. High Plains said Thursday.

One exporter's Houston bid had dropped to 48 cents over the March contract Thursday morning, down five cents from Wednesday morning's level of 53 cents. Another exporter's Galveston bid went to 49 cents from 52 cents.
"Gulf values are plummeting right now. Kansas City protein basis is weakening and we're pretty much just following that," a dealer in south-central Kansas said.
Basis values in cents/bu against KCBT wheat, cash=dollars/bu.
